parameter.name: momentum_lookback
parameter.meaning: n observed available daily raw Close intervals
parameter.domain_status: Provisional research search domain; no performance acceptance threshold; extend the domain if boundary performance improves

legacy_three: Always use features.mom3_positive and mom3_valid, including existing unknown semantics; never substitute raw-price direction at n=3

extended_momentum.calculation: complete available indexed history clipped to Date <= sessions[-1], pct_change(periods=n, fill_method=None), then reindex derived masks to sessions
extended_momentum.known: first n observations unknown; only finite computed change is known; available historical prices must be numeric, finite and strictly positive or fail explicitly
extended_momentum.active: known and computed change > 0; zero and negative changes are known false
extended_momentum.future: future Close values are not parsed or used for the calculation
extended_momentum.union: o01/m05 retain independent validity; unknown momentum cannot enter or become a recorded trigger
extended_momentum.loss: entry-branch snapshot uses derived momentum validity; every recorded branch must be known false before opportunity-loss exit
extended_momentum.age: later momentum or other branch cannot replace entry snapshot or reset age

next_required: new bound source for a successor experiment
limitations: Synthetic tests do not establish profitability
Only history actually provided by existing inputs is used; insufficient warmup remains unknown
No EX046 gate reuse for changed source
